product.name: DataLinkRuntime
product.headline: Code your data connections.
product.intro1: Write your data connection logic as Adapters, then run them directly.
product.intro2:
From code editing and dependency setup to execution, logs, and history tracking,
DataLinkRuntime provides a lightweight, self-hosted, complete runtime environment.

shell.workspaceSubtitle: Select an Adapter to inspect code, runtime settings, and execution history.
